<p align="center"><strong>The garden gate is open. Choose your ending.</strong></p>


<p align="center">The leaf bell rings. Outside, the carved mouths fall silent. A narrow stair takes you into the garden, and the iron gate swings open.</p>

<p align="center">You can see the road home. Then a pumpkin beside your shoe whispers, &quot;Please. My name was Ada.&quot; In the attic window, Elias still holds out the cup.</p>

<p align="center">A trail of unlit lanterns leads toward a greenhouse. A note tied to the first post reads: &quot;The gate saves one guest. The beacon can save every name. Five parts remain. - Elias&quot;</p>
